## Verification: **pass** Built with `npm run build` and ran `npm run start -- --port 3000` from a shell that sourced `.factory/sandbox/.runtime.env`. Every acceptance check was exercised against the running production server — curl against the served HTML, and Chromium via Playwright. Evidence in `/tmp/gh-aw/agent/bsf/media/`. ### 1\. Browser: the line reads `Total sent: $1,497.50` directly below the table — **pass** Opened (localhost/redacted) in Chromium. The accessibility snapshot ends with `- paragraph: "Total sent: $1,497.50"` as the last child of `
`, immediately after the table. The full-page screenshot shows it rendered below the five rows, with the dollar sign, the thousands comma and two decimals. The only console entry on the page is a pre-existing `404` for `/favicon.ico` — unrelated to this change. *Artifacts:* `check1-invoices-page-total.png`, `check1-console-errors.log` ### 2\. The literal string is unbroken in the served HTML — **pass** ``` $ curl -s (localhost/redacted) | grep -c 'Total sent: $1,497\.50' 1 $ grep -c 'Total sent: ' invoices.html 0 ``` The served markup is `

Total sent: $1,497.50

` — one unbroken string, no `` separator, so the JSX child was kept as a single template literal. I also checked this at the byte level (`od -c`): plain ASCII `$`, `,` and a regular space after the colon — no entity, no non-breaking space. And in the live DOM after hydration the paragraph has `childNodeCount: 1`, a single text node `"Total sent: $1,497.50"`, and is `table.nextElementSibling`. *Artifacts:* `check2-served-invoices.html`, `check2-check3-evidence.txt` ### 3\. The total counts the same invoices the button does — **pass** On the same page render: the button reads `Export 3 invoices as CSV`; the table still lists all five invoices, INV-1004 (`draft`) and INV-1005 (`void`) included; the total reads `$1,497.50`. The wrong-answer sentinel `2,878.50` appears **zero** times anywhere in the served HTML or in `document.body.textContent`. The table cells still print bare amounts (`245.00`, `1180.00`, `72.50`, `931.00`, `450.00`) — `formatAmount` was not widened, as the plan required. *Artifact:* `check1-invoices-page-total.png` (shows button, all five rows and the total together) ### 4\. `GET /invoices/export` is unchanged — **pass** ``` HTTP/1.1 200 OK cache-control: no-store content-disposition: attachment; filename="invoices.csv" content-type: text/csv; charset=utf-8 id,customer,amount,issued_on,status INV-1001,Acme Bakery,245.00,2026-10-02,paid INV-1002,Northwind Books,1180.00,2026-10-11,sent INV-1003,Globex Coffee,72.50,2026-10-19,paid ``` Header row plus exactly three data rows; no INV-1004 or INV-1005 in the body. *Artifacts:* `check4-export-headers.txt`, `check4-export-body.csv` ### Ways this could have been wrong but looked right I tried each of these; none broke it. - **A different route in.** Loaded `/` and clicked through to `/invoices` client-side rather than hitting the URL directly. Still exactly one `main > p`, one text node, `Total sent: $1,497.50`, button still `Export 3 invoices as CSV` — no duplicated or stale paragraph from the soft navigation. (`check3-client-nav-from-home.png`) - **Reload.** Hard reload after the client-side nav: 5 `tbody` rows, one total paragraph, same text. - **The second click.** Clicked the export button twice in the browser. Both clicks downloaded `invoices-2026-11-21.csv` with the identical three data rows, and the page text was unchanged after — the new total does not interact with the export. (`check4-browser-download-click1.csv`, `check4-browser-download-click2.csv`) - **Post-hydration DOM.** Checked the text node count in the live DOM, not just the server HTML, in case hydration re-split the children. It did not. ### Limits of what I checked Neither of these affects the verdict; recording them so the pass is not read as broader than it is. - **The empty case is not reachable in the running app.** `totalCents([])` returning `0` rather than `NaN` is covered by a unit test, but the invoice list is a hard-coded `readonly Invoice[]` in `lib/invoices.ts` with no way to empty it at runtime, so I could not exercise the zero-invoice page. No sandbox amendment is needed — per the manifest there is nothing to stub here, the data is a literal. - **I did not capture a before screenshot.** This is an addition, not a bug fix; the prior page had no total line at all, which the diff shows directly (the `

` is new). - **Chromium only**, per the manifest — the sandbox installs no other engine. The change is server-rendered text with no engine-specific API, so this is not a gap I think matters here. I did not run the test suite as evidence; that is a separate gate, and this verdict rests on the running app. > Generated by [Verifier](https://github.com/bsf-fixtures/ts-webapp/actions/runs/44860888239) for #19 · claude · opus50 · \~68 AIC · ⌖ \~27 AIC · ⊞ 2.6K · [◷](https://github.com/search?q=repo%3Absf-fixtures%2Fts-webapp+%22gh-aw-workflow-call-id%3A+bsf-fixtures%2Fts-webapp%2Ffactory-role-verifier%22&type=issues)
